cover.title: Gauri Ragini, folio from a Ragamala
cover.museum: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian
cover.credit: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection, Friends of the National Museum of Asian Art, S2018.1.49
cover.alt: A woman in saffron stands in a dark grove among peacocks and peahens, with red flowers and lotuses at her feet.

ganesha-mithila.title: Ganesha, a Mithila (Madhubani) painting
ganesha-mithila.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Gift of Pamela Elizabeth Ward in loving memory of her parents, William E. and Evelyn Svec Ward, 2005.84 (catalogued as “Large, multi-armed figure facing out”)
ganesha-mithila.alt: A magenta Ganesha with many arms sits on a lotus under a canopy, in bright pink, yellow and green, framed by a border of leaves.

lotus-offering.title: Offering lotus flowers to the Bodhisattva, Ajanta Cave 1
lotus-offering.medium: Copy of a wall painting, from Ajanta Frescoes (1915), plate X
lotus-offering.credit: Copy by Syed Ahmad, 1911, for Lady Herringham’s Ajanta Frescoes (India Society, London, 1915), plate X; Smithsonian Libraries scan via Internet Archive
lotus-offering.alt: A crowned bodhisattva with a pearl necklace; at left, devotees climb towards him carrying a tray heaped with white lotuses.

chhath.title: People bathing and praying in the holy river (a Chhath scene)
chhath.short: Chhath at the river, Patna style
chhath.credit: Wellcome Collection (catalogued as “People bathing and praying in the holy river Ganga”)
chhath.alt: Women in white stand in the river raising baskets of bananas, while women in red, pink and yellow sit on the bank with baskets of fruit.

two-mothers.title: Ghatotkacha embraces his cousin Abhimanyu while the two mothers also embrace, from the Paithan “Marriage of Abhimanyu and Vatsala” set
two-mothers.museum: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
two-mothers.credit: Los Angeles County Museum of Art, M.82.234.2
two-mothers.alt: In a Paithan storyteller’s painting, two cousins hug under palm fronds, and at right two veiled mothers in red and yellow saris embrace.

spice-market.title: Four women selling food-grains, vegetables and fruit
spice-market.short: A Patna market, Shiva Dayal Lal
spice-market.museum: Victoria and Albert Museum, via Wikimedia Commons
spice-market.credit: Shiva Dayal Lal (1815–1884). Victoria and Albert Museum, IS.66-1949; image via Wikimedia Commons
spice-market.alt: Four women in bright saris sit and stand behind baskets of grain and spices, yellow turmeric among them, with fruit, vegetables and clay pots.

royal-bath.title: The bath of King Mahajanaka of Mithila, Ajanta Cave 1
royal-bath.short: A king of Mithila is bathed, Ajanta
royal-bath.medium: Copy of a wall painting, from Ajanta Frescoes (1915), plate XIV
royal-bath.credit: Copy for Lady Herringham’s Ajanta Frescoes (India Society, London, 1915), plate XIV; Smithsonian Libraries scan via Internet Archive
royal-bath.alt: In a palace hall hung with pearls, women attend a crowned king seated for his ceremonial bath.

holi.title: Holi being played in a courtyard
holi.credit: British Library, Add.Or.939; image via Wikimedia Commons
holi.alt: In a long hall with a striped floor, a crowd dances with raised arms; drummers play a dhol and a daf and a woman sprays colour from a long pichkari.

fugdi.title: Fugdi, print no. 102 of the Chitrashala Press
fugdi.credit: Chitrashala Press, Pune. Wellcome Collection (catalogued as “A girl and boy dance”)
fugdi.alt: In a garden, two figures in red and gold cross hands and lean back to spin, while two women behind them dance with arms raised.

baraat.title: A wedding procession by night: the groom in a palanquin, with musicians and torch-bearers
baraat.alt: Under a starry sky, torch-bearers, drummers and trumpeters lead a groom in a crown, seated in a red-canopied palanquin.

blessing.title: Vatsala and Abhimanyu being blessed by elders, from the Paithan “Marriage of Abhimanyu and Vatsala” set
blessing.museum: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
blessing.credit: Los Angeles County Museum of Art, M.85.297.6
blessing.alt: Under scalloped arches, a veiled bride bows with joined hands while women in nine-yard saris raise their hands to bless her and elders sit beside a crowned king.

lotus.title: Vishnu on Ananta, the Endless Serpent
lotus.medium: Gum tempera and gold on paper
lotus.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection; Severance and Greta Millikin Purchase Fund 2018.155

paper.title: Ingres hand-made paper, from a sample book of French papers
paper.credit: Paper sample from a Canson & Montgolfier sample book, 1922, Getty Research Institute via Internet Archive
